_comment: AIMail agent-side contract — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Consumers (Python pysdk/aimail_contract.py, TypeScript tssdk/packages/mail-core/src/contract.ts) MUST equal these values; tests/contract/check-contract-single-source.py fails the L0 gate on any drift.
notes: Boundary (owner ruling 2026-09-27, breaker = rename commit d701dae 2026-09-03). The legitimate `aimail` surface = product/repo/framework/CLI name + directory name (~/.aimail) + env-var prefix (AIMAIL_*): these are NOT agent-internal contract names and must not be judged violations by this manifest. This manifest constrains only the **agent-internal contract surface**: skill/toolset registration name (agentmail), binding file name (agentmail.json), pointer file name (.agentmail), inbound path (/aimail/inbound). Verdict = the host builds the skill table from the frontmatter `name:` and looks up by `/{name}` (hermes-agent/agent/skill_commands.py); directory name skills/agentmail + name: aimail => the routing skills=['agentmail'] always misses (gateway log `Skill 'agentmail' not found`) => mail is still delivered but the agent never gets the 6-step reply protocol. Inbound ports (owner ruling 2026-10-25): ONE common default `inbound_port = 9099`, for hosts whose SDK owns the listener (dsh/pi); on port conflict the runtime re-selects an available port (bind probe — the ACTUAL bind result is the source of truth) and the confirmed callback (`address --inbound-live --inbound-url`) pins the real endpoint. Hosts where the host gateway owns the port (hermes, deerflow, openclaw) carry NO default in this contract — each host's adapter layer discovers the actual port (per-host adaptation) and the confirmed callback always carries the real URL, no exceptions. hermes is the only path exception = /webhooks/aimail-inbound (the hermes gateway's own route name aimail-inbound). pull/push: an empty registered value webhook_url = pull (the gateway goes to fetch; **empty is not a defect**), non-empty = push; but the webhook_url inside the binding file agentmail.json is always the local receiving endpoint, never the registered value. Not covered this batch (next batch): Rust (gateway/bridge repos) — the contract source contains no bridge keys (owner ruling 2026-09-28 SDK de-bridging: the bridge = the CLI's environment responsibility, not part of the agent-internal contract surface).
